required_routes: National Assembly Library / National Library periodical or newspaper archive
contemporaneous company/university biographies that reproduce the selection

promotion_criteria: Recover original or faithfully reproduced roster with more than isolated individual membership evidence.
Recover selection date and selection mechanism/candidate frame.
Establish whether this was a finite selected list versus a descriptive feature series.
Do not infer roster from the 2007 ChosunBiz trend article.
